depiction_rules.notes: A distinct ordinary adult mother beside Yashoda in D045 stanza 4. She is not Yashoda and should remain visually distinct.

visual_bible.face: distinct gentle face, different from Yashoda’s oval face
visual_bible.skin: warm medium-brown mineral pigment, clearly brown and not saturated orange; skin-only red-minus-blue under about 120
visual_bible.hair: dark hair simply gathered under a muted veil
visual_bible.build: ordinary adult proportions, two attached arms and hands
visual_bible.clothing: simple muted olive or dusty rose village sari with modest jewelry; distinguish from Yashoda’s cream/saffron palette

continuity_markers: One distinct adult mother in muted olive or dusty rose village dress; not merged with Yashoda.
never: no duplicate Rohini within one scene
no royal crown, palace costume, heavy jewelry, glossy skin or extra limbs
